description: Dependency audit (bundle) — One call: should I install this package? Returns an OK / REVIEW / CAUTION / BLOCK verdict fusing registry health (latest version, release cadence, license), known vulnerabilities for the version (OSV), and npm deprecation and download signals. For coding agents vetting a dependency before adding it. Price: $0.02 USDC (Base, via x402).

ecosystem.description: optional: npm (default), pypi, cargo, go, maven, nuget, rubygems

name: dev_dependency_audit
